rules.CA-AGE: policy age = TDATE year - SISSUE year, minus one before the anniversary month/day; fee zero from age 10
rules.CA-CHG: surrender charge = half_up(cash * fee / 10000); surrender = cash - charge - loan
rules.CA-CNFL: TSEQ == SSEQ with different transaction bytes is CNFL
rules.CA-D: D death quote: ODEATH = max(face, cash) - loan; zero amount required; like Q it posts interest and advances SSEQ/SDATE/SLAST but does not close or settle the policy (no cash/loan/face movement)
rules.CA-DATE: invalid TDATE, or TDATE before SDATE -> DATE
rules.CA-DUPL: replayed transaction (TSEQ == SSEQ, identical 40 bytes) is DUPL and does not change state
rules.CA-HIGH: high values just below the cap commit
rules.CA-L: L increases SLOAN; loan above cash -> FUND
rules.CA-NEGA: negative TAMT -> NEGA; negative zero D0 is accepted as zero
rules.CA-NPOL: TID != SID -> NPOL after echoing cash/loan
rules.CA-ORDR: TSEQ behind the state sequence (or non-positive) is ORDR; TDATE before SDATE is DATE
rules.CA-OVER: cash + interest > 99999999999 -> OVER with OINT zeroed and state rolled back; SCASH=MAXAMT 19000101->20250101 gives interest 406526027393 > MAXAMT
rules.CA-P: P adds the premium to cash after interest
rules.CA-PREC: status precedence: STAT, NPOL, ORDR/DUPL/CNFL, FORM, PACK, NEGA, OVER(amount), DATE, then arithmetic; TYPE/AMNT/FUND/OVER after interest roll the state back
rules.CA-Q: Q requires zero amount (AMNT otherwise); posts interest and advances SSEQ/SDATE/SLAST
rules.CA-R: R decreases SLOAN; loan below zero -> FUND
rules.CA-RATE: period-end rate at each INSRATE boundary applied to the interest formula
rules.CA-RAW: raw byte semantics: F-sign inputs echo as C-sign outputs; negative zero; transaction bytes preserved
rules.CA-SEQ: TSEQ <= 0 or TSEQ < SSEQ -> ORDR; TSEQ == SSEQ -> DUPL when TREC equals SLAST else CNFL; any TSEQ > SSEQ continues
rules.CA-STAT: invalid state -> STAT, OCASH/OLOAN stay zero, SREC unchanged
rules.CA-SURR: surrender value when loan is present
rules.CA-TIE: interest = half_up(cash * rate * days / 3650000); exact .5 ties round up (half-up on non-negative values)
rules.CA-W: W subtracts from cash; cash below zero or below the loan -> FUND
rules.DT-1900: 1900 is not a leap year (Gregorian century rule); 19000228 valid, 19000229 invalid, 19000301 ordinal 59
rules.DT-CONV: WYEAR, WMD and WORD (days since 19000101) written for valid dates
rules.DT-DAY: day 0, 31 in a 30-day month, 32, and 30 in February invalid; 31 in a 31-day month valid
rules.DT-PREC: invalid month and invalid day in one value: rejected once, WMD/WORD not written
rules.DT-RANGE: years 1900..2099 valid; 1899 and 2100 invalid; zero and negative fullwords invalid
rules.DT-SIGN: negative or zero WDATE: WVALID=8 and WYEAR/WMD/WORD untouched
rules.PK-DIGIT: any digit nibble A-F in any position rejects (R15=8); positions 0, 3, 6 and high/low nibble
rules.PK-SIGN: sign nibble classes: C, D, F accepted (including negative zero D0); A, B, E and digit nibbles rejected
rules.PK-VALID: all seven digit nibbles 0-9 and a C/D/F sign nibble validate (R15=0)
rules.RT-AGE: WAGE >= 10 zeroes the fee; WAGE 9 keeps it; negative WAGE keeps it
rules.RT-BAND5: TDATE >= 20250101 -> rate 325, fee 350 (open-ended, e.g. 20991231 and beyond)
rules.RT-DOMAIN: direct domain is the binary fullword TDATE and WAGE only: INSRATE does not validate dates; a raw invalid date such as 20241399 is banded by numeric comparison and TDATE < 19000101 writes neither WRATE nor WFEE
rules.VL-DATE: SISSUE and SDATE must both be valid dates (INSDATE rules)
rules.VL-FIRST: SSEQ=0 requires SLAST all zero and SDATE=SISSUE
rules.VL-HIST: SSEQ>0 requires SLAST to carry SID, SSEQ and SDATE (historical checkpoint)
rules.VL-ID: SID must be eight CP037 digits F0-F9; blanks, letters, lower nibble > 9 and X'00' reject
rules.VL-LOAN: SLOAN may equal but not exceed SCASH
rules.VL-MAX: amounts 0..99999999999 cents; MAXAMT accepted, MAXAMT+1 rejected
rules.VL-NEG: negative face, cash or loan rejects (D sign with nonzero digits); negative zero is numerically zero
rules.VL-OK: well-formed first-state and continued-state masters validate (R15=0, WVALID=0)
rules.VL-PACK: SFACE, SCASH and SLOAN must be valid packed decimal (sign and digit nibbles)
rules.VL-PAD: SPAD (7 reserved bytes) must be zero
rules.VL-PREC: when several validations fail, R15 is still 8 and no scratch other than WDATE/WYEAR/WMD/WORD/WVALID changes
rules.VL-SEQ: SSEQ must be >= 0 (negative fullword rejects); large positive accepted
rules.VL-TAIL: STAIL (40 trailing bytes) must be zero

undefined_and_not_asserted: R14 high byte after BALR (ILC/CC/program mask)
any register beyond R0-R15 general registers
